citations.quote: three key factors, at least one of which must be present in order to give rise to a licensing obligation
secondly, the family office is carrying on a business in the provision of such services; and thirdly, the business is carried on in Hong Kong.

readings.distinction: The defensible alternatives already identified are an inclusive threshold, a necessary-only threshold with an unspecified sufficient trigger, and a weaker contextual cumulative inference. After considering these, inclusive OR is preferred for the exact antecedent wording. There is no negation to reattach, and neither exclusive OR nor a mixed connective grouping has textual support. This reading consolidates existing proposals rather than claiming a newly discovered alternative.

“That business” presupposes identification of the business referenced by business. The vocabulary does not specify the value of hong_kong when that business is absent or unidentified; unknown inputs must remain unknown.
